items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: I think he did a couple of woodwind things with Teddy and Roy Eldridge

ctx.x: Because I remember that -- some of the things that Mildred was singing, out at -- Alec Wilder had done the arrangements. So was that the time?
Well I think he did a couple of woodwind things with Teddy and Roy Eldridge, we're on, remember he had a -- I don't know what date that was. I think he did "All The Things You Are," I'm not sure.

items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: Red Norvo had a group there.

ctx.x: brother Joe... And Clyde Hart, right? No drums. Red Norvo had a group there. But what they would do, we played until people came in the place. Then they kept us upstairs, feeding us, they had a table set and fed us, and he entertained all night until everybody went home, then they called us to close the joint up. Now, I was wise to that. Shit, you know, we never got a chance to play while people were in there! You ready for that?
Was that when you made that record with Joe Marsala and them, at that same time?
